feature_concept: easy-lima is a project-oriented wrapper around Lima for macOS and Linux with one persistent Ubuntu VM per registered project. V1 adds nested project selection, native Lima configuration and limited presets, deliberate storage, SSH/VS Code access, named isolated Git identities, diagnosis/recovery, and adoption of the existing prototype. Automatic storage moves, snapshots/cloning, multiple environments per project, Windows/WSL, and Workshop integration are deferred.
